h1: Custom Folding Eyewear for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom folding eyewear in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for travel and giveaways. Get your quote today.
introHtml: Custom folding eyewear packs flat for easy storage and travel, making them a smart choice for trade show giveaways or employee welcome kits. Unlike standard sunglasses, these fold into compact cases that slip into a pocket or bag. Choose from several frame colors and add your logo with pad printing or debossing for a clean, professional look.
heroAltText: Custom folding eyewear with logo on compact case for travel and promotional use
